title: game of life
how: random binary matrix → a dead cell with 3 live neighbours comes alive, a live one with 2–3 stays, the rest die → leftovers lock into objects → some sit still, some blink, some crawl across
made: C + ffmpeg life filter + B3/S23 + h.264

title: rule 90
how: random row of 1s and 0s → each new row: every cell = left neighbour xor right neighbour → the rows stack → triangles inside triangles appear on their own

title: rule 110
how: random row of 1s and 0s → each new row: every cell + its 2 neighbours looked up in an 8-entry table → the rows stack → particles appear and crash into each other

title: mandelbrot
how: every pixel is a number c → repeat z = z² + c → if z blows up, colour it by how fast → if it never does, it's in the set → zoom in and the edge never ends
made: C + ffmpeg mandelbrot + z = z² + c + h.264
